children.instructions: Optionally specify sublinks to one or more category pages

interval.instructions: Time between slide transitions (in milliseconds, default 5000)

postType.instructions: Auto is recommended. It detects quick answers, guides, reviews, and shopping posts; choose a type to override it.

pageLayout.instructions: Auto adds a sidebar to longer guides, reviews, and shopping posts. Simple and Sidebar are manual overrides.

shopEditEnabled.instructions: Turn off to hide Shop The Edit completely on this story.

shopEditItems.instructions: Add priority products here. Blank spaces are filled automatically from product links in the article.

atAGlance.instructions: Everything fills automatically when blank. Open only when you want to override the text or links.

firstHandExpertise.instructions: About the Author text. Defaults are used when blank.

content.instructions: Primary article editor. Write or paste the full post here, including headings, links, lists, and images.

productUrl.instructions: Paste the full product URL. It opens externally.

productEmbedHtml.instructions: Optional: paste a product embed iframe. It replaces the product image in Shop The Edit.

label.instructions: Internal note only. This will not appear on the website.

pastedText.instructions: Paste the copied table here exactly as it appears. The first set of values becomes the bold header row; the rest automatically fills the table from left to right. Tabs and line breaks both work.

columnCount.instructions: How many columns are in the table? Defaults to 3. Change this only when your table has a different number.

label.instructions: Optional internal note. This is only for finding the block quickly in the editor.

image.instructions: Drag an image here from the asset panel, or choose/replace it.

size.instructions: Auto is recommended. Use a manual size only when the image needs deliberate emphasis.

alignment.instructions: None aligns to the post text edge without wrapping. Left and Right use the expanded post width with text wrapping. Center does not wrap text.

spacing.instructions: Standard is recommended. Choose None when the image should sit flush against the surrounding content.

altText.instructions: Optional. When blank, the site creates alt text from the caption or filename.

linkUrl.instructions: Optional. Paste or edit the complete destination URL. Spaces in surrounding story text are preserved.

image.instructions: Drag an image here from the asset panel.

linkUrl.instructions: Optional. Paste or edit the complete image URL. Image links open externally by default.

layout.instructions: Auto uses the number and orientation of the photos.

size.instructions: Wide is the default for galleries.

getCategoryList.description: Returns a list Category in natural order.

getContinentList.description: Returns a list Continent in natural order.

pageLayout.title: Page Layout
pageLayout.description: Auto uses a sidebar for substantial guides, reviews, and shopping posts. Simple and Sidebar override the automation.

shopEditEnabled.title: Show Shop The Edit
shopEditEnabled.description: Disable to hide the entire Shop The Edit section on this story.

shopEditItems.title: Shop The Edit — Manual Items
shopEditItems.description: Manual products appear first; remaining spaces are selected from article links.

mainContentBlock1.description: Optional rich text shown in the main story flow. Leave blank if unused.

pastedText.title: Table Data

columnCount.title: Number of Columns
columnCount.description: Defaults to 3. Change this only if the pasted table has a different number of columns.
